purpose: Make repeated generic /wc launches sustain a useful execution -> integration -> planning/rescate -> successor-work loop without requiring one privileged /g chat to refill the backlog.
truth_boundary: The objective is sustained compounding of useful durable results, not exponential task-count inflation. This policy does not prove unattended invocation: the human still opens chats unless a separate runtime proves automatic launching.
human_action_target: The human should only need to launch the same /wc URL. Workers decide execution vs planning/integration/rescate from durable state.
frontier_target_rule: target_claimable = clamp(frontier_floor_absolute, ceil(1.5 * distinct_worker_beacons_in_last_10m), frontier_ceiling). This is a planning target, not a quota: never create filler to hit it.

role_selection.when: material recent returns without durable disposition/safe successor >= 3
role_selection.why: consume finished work before generating unrelated work

role_selection.when: useful claimable frontier < target_claimable and grounded unresolved project goals exist
role_selection.why: keep execution capacity supplied with bounded work

role_selection.when: replaceable >= 3 OR repeated collisions >= 3 OR repeated same-blocker PARTIAL/BOUNDARY >= 2 OR human routing friction is observed
role_selection.why: change the mechanism rather than adding more workers to a bottleneck

role_selection.when: a new allocator/control-plane/mechanism change lacks independent attack
none of the above outranks a concrete executable/recovery/verification job
role_selection.why: planning exists to feed production, not replace it

self_materializing_guide_jobs.rule: If a guide trigger is true but no compatible unclaimed guide job already represents it, compute a deterministic fingerprint from role + trigger + sorted exact evidence refs that caused the trigger. Use SHA-256 and first 12 lowercase hex chars. Atomically CREATE exactly one derived guide job at guide-<role-lower>-<fingerprint>.json. All contenders for the same state produce the same path/dedupe key; create-exists means use/reload existing work, never mint a per-worker variant.
anti_inflation: Do not create a new guide job if the same fingerprint already exists, is actively pinned, or has a terminal return.
Do not vary fingerprints by worker_id, current time, chat id or random salt.
Do not create jobs whose only output is more analysis.
A Planner may create 1-7 grounded successors, but fewer is correct when evidence supports fewer.
A guide job should not self-reproduce merely to keep a role alive. New guide work requires a materially changed trigger/evidence set or an explicit retryable residual boundary.

guide_done_contract.GUIDE_INTEGRATOR: Consume material returns, persist disposition, and materialize all currently grounded safe successors before returning.
guide_done_contract.GUIDE_PLANNER: Increase useful claimable frontier toward target using evidence-backed implementation/verification/integration work, not filler.
guide_done_contract.GUIDE_RESCATE: Make at least one mechanism-level intervention expected to increase useful output or remove a multiplicative bottleneck; diagnosis-only is incomplete.
guide_done_contract.GUIDE_CRITIC: Independently attack the new/weak mechanism and create a bounded repair/verification job when a software-solvable weakness is found.
guide_done_contract.GUIDE_STEWARD: Consume compatible local results into the delegated durable lane and expose grounded successors.

rotation.after_any_return: reload full state and continue with the highest-value role while context/authority remain adequate
rotation.after_lost_race: persist collision evidence when defined, reload immediately, and choose different useful work
rotation.after_planning: prefer executing or verifying one of the newly created jobs when safe instead of stopping after planning
rotation.after_integration: prefer a newly unlocked successor when safe
stop_only_when: context quality no longer supports safe continuation
all safe useful execution/recovery/guide/discovery work is exhausted

count_as_growth: terminal useful result consumed by a downstream step
grounded successor materialized and later claimed
reusable capability that unlocks multiple bounded jobs
mechanism change that measurably reduces stale/collision/human-routing cost
compounding_measurement.desired_evidence: Observe multiple consecutive generations where useful consumed results create >1 grounded successor on average and those successors are actually claimed/executed without human routing. Until then describe compounding as PARTIAL/UNPROVEN rather than exponential.
